newsitem.title: USA: Vivus falls on new prescription data.
newsitem.headline: Vivus falls on new prescription data.

text.p: Shares of Vivus Inc fell sharply Monday amid concerns over the latest prescription data for the company's treatment for male impotence, analysts said.
Although Vivus was not immediately available for comment, analysts said the latest data showed 18,332 prescriptions written during the week ended April 25, down about two percent from the prior week.
Analysts said they did not view the week-to-week sales fluctuations as highly significant, and that longer term sales trends remained strong.

"One week does not a trend make," said PaineWebber analyst Charles Olsziewski, who has a buy recommendation on the stock. He said the volatility in Vivus shares was pronounced by the large number of players with short positions.
